scope: Seven retained complete calves, while paper describes ten antibiotic-trial calves. Two reserved calves permit bounded internal transfer only. No untreated controls, dose-response or molecule-specific mechanism identification.
calibration: Mean DMS emission at-48/-24h, difference and age at first post-dose row; five post-dose points are forecast. Other VOCs and disease labels excluded.
timing: Prediction at treatment administration from pre-dose breath samples and scheduled post-dose time.
